name: 73170 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73170 (Oklahoma City) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73170 (Oklahoma City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73170 (Oklahoma City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
